summary: Full backend + frontend testing of alternativ-investieren.com portal. 11/11 pytest backend tests pass (auth, provider CRUD, list/filter). All 12 frontend routes render correctly. All 3 calculators (Rendite/Diversifikation/Steuer with DE/AT/CH switching) update reactively. Admin login → dashboard → create provider → delete provider round-trip works. ProviderComparison filter/sort/regulation controls change table content correctly. Impressum contains required Xolo Go OÜ / Markus Gildemeister / Tallinn data.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes Bearer + cookie fallback in get_current_user (line 63). Since spec says Bearer-only, cookie branch is dead code and slightly weakens threat model clarity; consider removing.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec (browsers reject). It works currently because Bearer auth doesn't need credentials, but should be tightened to explicit origins before production.
seed_admin correctly updates password if changed (idempotent). bcrypt hash generated at runtime (starts with $2b$) – OK.

No brute-force lockout implemented on /api/auth/login. Spec's playbook mentions 5-fail lockout; not implemented but task note says Bearer flow (not full auth playbook), so likely out of scope. Flag for future hardening.
seed_data_creation: None. Startup seed created 3 sample providers + admin user automatically. Test artifacts (TEST_* providers) cleaned up by their own DELETE steps.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py uses pytest, covers auth (login success + wrong password German 401 + /me protected) and full provider CRUD with GET-verification pattern. Frontend key testids verified: provider-comparison, provider-table, filter-sort, filter-min-investment, filter-regulation, filter-risk, admin-new-provider, form-name/form-save, admin-row-{id}, admin-delete-{id}, result-konservativ/realistisch/optimistisch, diversifikation-advice, result-steuer, result-netto, input-land (AT/CH switchable). BaFin filter on /crowdlending/ correctly returns 0 rows since neither seeded crowdlending provider (Alpha/Gamma) is bafin_regulated — the empty state 'Noch keine Anbieter für diese Auswahl' renders (data-testid=providers-empty).
